snippet.title: TAIKUNDA — Official Reveal Trailer | Real-Time Steampunk Strategy (Solo Indie)
snippet.description:
TAIKUNDA — a real-time, three-layer steampunk strategy game.

Command a flying colony. Outrun a wall of nothing. Trade broadsides between airships. Colony, campaign, and combat — one continuous run, no turns, no second chances.

🛸  Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3144260/Taikunda/
🌐  taikunda.com  |  dreamtimestudios.dev

Built solo in Unreal Engine 5 by an Australian indie studio. Coming Soon to Steam.

──────────────────────
THREE LAYERS, ONE RUN

• Colony — Build a steampunk floating city across multiple platforms. 30+ buildings. Workers have names, families, faith.
• Campaign — Navigate a 21x21 galaxy one tile at a time. Outrun the Voidwall — an expanding ring of destruction.
• Combat — Real-time naval battles between steampunk airships. Sloops, Brigantines, Galleons. Port and starboard broadsides reload independently.
──────────────────────
